controlled_change.unchanged: Byte-identical v1 inputs: 793 answers, 8845 scored claims, 51953 selected claim/evidence-sentence pairs, pair order/provenance, BM25 retrieval, claim/token/window geometry, 35 feature formulas, source-group OOF LR readout, C/weights/labels/projection/thresholds/metrics.
controlled_change.changed: Only frozen NLI tokenizer/checkpoint: v1 tasksource/ModernBERT-base-nli -> official NLIChecker default ynie/roberta-large-snli_mnli_fever_anli_R1_R2_R3-nli.

scope.answers: Exactly the existing 634 fit and 159 calibration llama-2-7b-chat QA answers.
scope.claims: Reuse exact automatic claim text/spans from semantic_baseline/cuda_variant/plans.jsonl. Retain punctuation-only records in an explicit audit list but do not treat them as factual claims or NLI hypotheses; this fixed isalnum rule uses no annotation.
scope.windows: Evaluation later uses the unchanged eligible four-original-BPE stride-one windows; preparation derives only label-free token-to-claim geometry.
scope.test: No official validation/test file or path is opened.

evidence_units.passages: Parse exactly the original line-start passage 1/2/3 headers and retain body plus original document coordinates and hashes.
evidence_units.sentences: Within each passage body, split at newline or .!?/CJK equivalents followed by whitespace/end; retain closing punctuation, protect fixed abbreviations, initials, dotted acronyms and list markers; trim only outer whitespace.
evidence_units.provenance: Every selected item retains passage id, sentence id, passage-relative and document-relative character ranges, exact text and SHA256.

retrieval.unit: Independently rank sentences inside each of the three passages for every answer claim.
retrieval.tokenization: Unicode alphanumeric words, casefolded; no stemming, stopword removal, synonym expansion, question expansion or citation deletion.
retrieval.formula: Robertson BM25: idf=ln(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)), k1=1.2, b=0.75; sum once per unique query term.
retrieval.selection: Top min(2,N) sentences per passage by descending BM25; exact ties use earlier sentence id. Zero-overlap claims still receive the deterministic first two sentences.
retrieval.labels: Question labels, hallucination spans, token risk, prior detector scores and NLI outputs are unavailable to retrieval.

nli.pair: Premise is one exact selected evidence sentence; hypothesis is one exact automatic answer claim. Source markers are metadata, not added to text.
nli.pair_order: answer order, claim id, passage id 1/2/3, retrieval rank 1/2.
nli.extraction: Separate explicit CUDA FP32 eval/inference command, cuda_fp32_sdpa_math_batch16_v1; batch 16; no training.

claim_features.per_passage: Over its selected one/two evidence pairs: max/mean E, max/mean N, max/mean C, union query-term coverage, and top BM25 score (8 x 3).
claim_features.global: Across every selected pair/source: max/mean E, N and C; max/mean per-passage query coverage; 1-maxE; max(maxC,1-maxE); and maxC*(1-maxE) (11).

readout.label: Opened only after all frozen NLI caches exist. A scored fit claim is positive iff any original lexical BPE assigned to it has the unchanged human risk label.
readout.learned: One StandardScaler plus L2 logistic regression, liblinear, fixed C=0.1 and seed; no architecture or hyperparameter selection.
readout.crossfit: Five-fold GroupKFold by locked source-connected group supplies every fit claim prediction; full-fit model predicts calibration claims.
readout.weights: Within each training fold: equal source-group mass, then equal answer mass, then equal claim mass; labels supply binary class balance.
readout.projection: Assign each lexical original BPE its claim score. A four-BPE window receives the maximum score among its lexical BPE claims; answer score is its maximum eligible window.
readout.thresholds: For raw and learned scores separately, select window and answer F1 thresholds only on fit (learned uses OOF fit predictions); ties use precision then higher threshold; freeze for calibration.
readout.report: Report both raw and learned fit/calibration window and answer AUROC/AP/F1. Calibration is reporting only, never model/threshold/feature selection.

v1_semantics.stage_gate: initialize -> CPU prepare -> CPU check. After code review only: gpu-smoke -> extract. A separate CPU score command then opens development gold and trains the readout.
v1_semantics.preparation_repair: First label-free prepare stopped because 7/8852 inherited automatic records contain punctuation only (``` or "":") and therefore cannot own a lexical BPE or form a BM25 query. The failure is retained. Before any label/model access, v1 was refrozen to retain those 7 records in an audit list and score the other 8845 alphanumeric claims.
v1_semantics.limitations: Retrieval failure and NLI failure remain conflated. Sentence-level claim broadcasting is intentionally coarser than token attribution. This is a new candidate, not a modified formal baseline.

official_identity.official_pair_orientation: NLIChecker._check tokenizes batch_references first and batch_claims second: reference is premise, claim is hypothesis.
official_identity.is_joint_false: CheckerBase.check flattens each claim across each reference passage and each optional reference segment, then calls _check(..., is_joint=False). Our already flattened evidence-sentence/claim pairs match only this individual-pair orientation/order concept.
official_identity.official_tokenization: max_length=512, truncation=True, padding=True, return_token_type_ids=True, batch_size default16.
official_identity.official_nonjoint_segment_merge: Per reference passage, official merge_ret gives Entailment priority, then Contradiction, else Neutral. This ablation does not use that discrete merge.

checkpoint.architecture: RobertaForSequenceClassification; 24 layers, hidden1024, 16 heads, 356412419 parameters, FP32 weights.

execution.pair: Exact v1 evidence sentence as reference/premise and exact v1 automatic answer claim as claim/hypothesis.
execution.tokenization: Use official max_length512/truncation/padding/token-type setting. CPU prepare first proves every untruncated pair <=512 and official encoding is therefore lossless.
execution.GPU: Explicit later CUDA0 FP32 eval/inference, SDPA math, batch16, TF32/autocast/compile disabled; no automatic fallback.
execution.readout: Private import of v1 reuses its learning/projection/score functions; only output path and validated probability-cache loader are rebound.
execution.stages: initialize -> CPU prepare -> CPU check; after review only gpu-smoke -> extract; score is a separate CPU process and only then opens development gold.

not_full_RefChecker: No RefChecker LLM extractor or its triplet/subsentence RCClaim representation; uses the pre-existing v1 automatic sentence claims.
No RefChecker reference splitting/retriever or full-reference checking; uses v1 BM25 top-2 evidence sentences.
No official argmax merge_ret, multi-passage merge, strict/major/soft response aggregator, localization component, or RefChecker benchmark labels/metrics.

Uses our supervised RAGTruth claim-risk LR and original four-BPE window projection. Therefore report only as an in-house checkpoint/backbone ablation, never as RefChecker reproduction or formal baseline.

resource_estimate.warning: Estimate only; gpu-smoke must measure before extraction. No fit/score or GPU has run at protocol freeze.
